sloka: न अराजके जन पदे यज्ञ शीला द्विजातयः ।सत्राणि अन्वासते दान्ता ब्राह्मणाः सम्शित व्रताः ॥२-६७-१३॥
transliteration: na arājake jana pade yajña śīlā dvijātayaḥ ।satrāṇi anvāsate dāntā brāhmaṇāḥ samśita vratāḥ ॥2-67-13॥

translations.english: In a country without a king, selfcontrolled brahmins in charge of sacrificial ceremonies, wellversed in the study of Vedas and strict followers of austerity will not function.
